name: Qualitative and mixed methods
description: Review methodological coherence, sampling, reflexivity, analytic evidence, and integration across qualitative and quantitative strands.

source_notes.purpose: Qualitative and mixed-method reporting standards with reviewer considerations

limitations: Quality criteria must fit the stated qualitative tradition.

The skill does not inspect private transcripts or recode participant material.
